description: I’m delighted that many of the bills I sponsored this session are on their way to becoming law. One bill was already signed into law. Another seven are on the Governor’s desk—just one step away from becoming law. And four more bills passed the General Assembly in another vehicle.
paid_for_by: Authorized by Friends of Julie Palakovich Carr, Treasurer Yamil Hernandez Contact Julie at Julie@JuliePalakovichCarr
title: Victories from the 2025 Legislative Session — Julie Palakovich Carr
